name: Three CNOTs make a SWAP
summary: The SWAP gate is equal to three alternating CNOT gates.
description:
A SWAP gate equals three CNOTs in which the middle one has its control and target reversed. In the ZX-calculus this is proved by deforming the diagram so that the [bialgebra rule](../bialgebra/) applies to the first two CNOTs, after which the remaining pair of CNOTs [cancels](../cnot-cancellation/).

This identity is used in routing quantum circuits on restricted architectures, where SWAPs must be implemented with the native two-qubit gates.
